title: Spending 60 billion USD in Three Months: Anthropic Signs a 9.1 Billion USD Long-term Computing Power Contract with Mining Company Riot, Locking Until 2048
excerpt: Bloomberg, citing informed sources, reported that Anthropic has finalized a long-term cloud computing contract worth $9.1 billion with Bitcoin mining company Ri
content_html:
Bloomberg, citing informed sources, reported that Anthropic has finalized a long-term cloud computing contract worth $9.1 billion with Bitcoin mining company Riot Platforms, with a term of 20 years. This is not an isolated transaction but one of several large-scale capacity procurement agreements that Anthropic has recently signed, reflecting the ongoing pressure on the capacity supply side for AI companies.

After the announcement, Riot's stock surged 25% in after-hours trading, reaching $24.40. The contract covers 191 megawatts of computing power, equivalent to powering about 143,000 households at the same time. The computing power comes from Riot's data center campus in Rockdale, Texas. If both parties exercise the two five-year extension options included in the contract, the total value could reach as high as $16.1 billion, with the agreement lasting until June 2048.

Even more impressive is the comparison. Prior to this, Anthropic had already signed a $10 billion cloud computing agreement with Volta Infra Holdings, a infrastructure startup that had only been established for a few months; in May of this year, it also reached an agreement with xAI, Elon Musk's company, committing to purchase nearly $45 billion in computing resources. Together, these three agreements exceed $60 billion, revealing the aggressive approach of the developer of Claude in purchasing computing power.

content_html_zh:
彭博社援引知情人士消息称，Anthropic 已与比特币挖矿公司 Riot Platforms 敲定了一份价值 91 亿美元的长期云计算合同，期限为 20 年。 这并不是一笔孤立的交易，而是Anthropic近期签署的几项大规模产能采购协议之一，反映出AI公司产能供给端持续面临的压力。

消息公布后，Riot 股价在盘后交易中飙升 25%，达到 24.40 美元。 该合同涵盖191兆瓦的计算能力，相当于同时为约143,000个家庭供电。 计算能力来自 Riot 位于德克萨斯州罗克代尔的数据中心园区。 如果双方执行合同中包含的两项五年延期选择权，总价值可能高达161亿美元，协议有效期至2048年6月。

更令人印象深刻的是对比。 此前，Anthropic已经与成立仅几个月的基础设施初创公司Volta Infra Holdings签署了价值100亿美元的云计算协议；今年5月，它还与埃隆·马斯克的公司xAI达成协议，承诺购买近450亿美元的计算资源。 这三项协议合计超过 600 亿美元，揭示了 Claude 开发商在购买算力方面的激进做法。
